title: DaKanji radk file
description: The radicals of a dakanji-radicals archive with their stroke count, in a file whose name contains `radk` (e.g. radkfile.json). Keys other than the ones below are ignored.

version.description: Version of the source data, not read.

radicals.description: Maps every radical to its data. A radical with a `code` is stored under the character DaLang maps that code to.

code.description: RADKFILE's JIS code for radicals without their own character, null otherwise.

kanji.description: Kanji containing the radical, not read (the krad file links them).
